title: One Room of Happiness
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A 14-year-old girl, beaten by her parents, sexually abused by a teacher and bullied at school, is stopped from ending her life by a masked man and runs away to live with him. He names her Sachi ('happiness'); police treat it as a kidnapping. The two pledge to marry if they escape and to die together if caught.
life_message: It holds up the longing of a hurt child for a place of safety and happiness, while questioning whether this one is right.

winners_losers: Sachi's abusers are condemned; the masked man is a sympathetic outlaw, and the police and family are cast as threats. Sympathy goes to the runaways' private refuge over law and family.
